details: A pressure-triggered handover at Governess epoch 41 persists transaction epoch 41 across reload.
After the restarted Governess advances its fencing epoch to 99, the active handover rejects a second start and retains transaction epoch 41.
Replacing the pressure-triggered handover epoch with undefined made the new producer regression fail on handoverEpoch 41; restoring the implementation returned 77/77 Governess tests green.
A sandboxed attempt failed when the proxy integration could not bind localhost and surfaced EADDRINUSE.
The proxy integration passed independently with loopback binding allowed, then the complete sequential suite passed uninterrupted with zero failures.
